title: Re: Strike at Storeroom 5A
description: Re: Strike at Storeroom 5A — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Wally Wanka

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 5A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Wally Wanka

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 12 Candy Fabricators in Storeroom 5A and return to Wally Wanka in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

No doubt your mission to date has caused Abaddon a logistical nightmare since his Candy Fabricators are summarily being wiped out. Just think that for every Candy Fabricator you destroy, Abaddon is getting another brain tumor. There, doesn't that just make every moment of this quest worth it?

Head to Storeroom 5A and lay waste to the Candy Fabricators there to keep Abaddon from being able to make any more of those disgusting candies. When the machines are sputtering piles of parts return to me, Wally Wanka, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

I wish I had half the zeal you do when you are destroying those machines! Ah, to feel young again...and skinny. Let me know if you want to try your hand at this mission again.

Objectives:

  • Candy Fabricators

Client level range: 46–100
